column1: # s1b.tsv -- the mutations base#1462 (config-gen S1b) requires
# script/test/mutation-probe.sh to report PINNED. One row per behaviour:
# <id> TAB <subject> TAB <spec> TAB <old> TAB <new> TAB <witness>, the contract of
# once in <subject> and is replaced by <new> (empty <new> deletes), both
# written with the three escapes \\ \t \n. `just test mutation-required`
# probes every row and passes only when each one is PINNED.
